metadata.question: Does vegetation cover increase in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan from February 23, 2020 to April 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Location: A circular region in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan (center at [80.0E, 37.5N], 30 km radius). - Dates: Feb 23, 2020 ±5 days and Apr 29, 2020 ±5 days. - Collections: Primary: Sentinel-2 SR harmonized; Fallback if empty: Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level 2. 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - Mask clouds: Sentinel-2 QA60 bits 10/11; Landsat 8 QA_PIXEL bits (cloud, shadow, cirrus, snow). - Compute NDVI, then evaluate valid pixels. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If collection empty for a window even after fallback: C1. - If valid NDVI pixels count is 0 for a window: C2. - If computed fractions are null/NaN or outside [0,1]: C3. - Otherwise compare vegetation cover fraction (NDVI > 0.2) between windows. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Helpers const evalPromise = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject)); // Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([80.0, 37.5]); // Taklamakan Desert near Hotan const region = center.buffer(30000); // 30 km radius const scale = 1000; const win1 = {start: '2020-02-18', end: '2020-02-28', label: 'Feb23±5d'}; const win2 = {start: '2020-04-24', end: '2020-05-04', label: 'Apr29±5d'}; // Sentinel-2 processors function maskS2sr(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(mask); } function s2NdviComposite(start, end) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .map(maskS2sr) .map(img => img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')); return {col: col, img: col.median(), sensor: 'Sentinel-2'}; } // Landsat 8 processors (fallback if empty) function maskL8(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // cirrus .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // snow return img.updateMask(mask); } function l8NdviComposite(start, end) { const colRaw = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start, end); const col = colRaw .map(maskL8) .map(img => { const sr = img.select(['SR_B4','SR_B5']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return sr.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); }); return {col: col, img: col.median(), sensor: 'Landsat-8'}; } async function getWindowMetrics(win) { // Try Sentinel-2 let s2 = s2NdviComposite(win.start, win.end); let s2Size = await evalPromise(s2.col.size()); let sensorUsed = 'Sentinel-2'; let img = s2.img; let sizeUsed = s2Size; // If empty, try Landsat 8 if (!s2Size || s2Size === 0) { const l8 = l8NdviComposite(win.start, win.end); const l8Size = await evalPromise(l8.col.size()); if (!l8Size || l8Size === 0) { return {empty: true, msg: `${win.label}: No images in S2 or L8.`}; } sensorUsed = 'Landsat-8'; img = l8.img; sizeUsed = l8Size; } // Compute metrics const totalCount = ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('constant'); const validCount = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const meanNdvi = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const coverCount = img.gt(0.2).selfMask().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const [tot, val, mean, cov] = await Promise.all([ evalPromise(totalCount), evalPromise(validCount), evalPromise(meanNdvi), evalPromise(coverCount) ]); if (val === 0) { return {noValid: true, msg: `${win.label}: 0 valid pixels after masking.`}; } const coverFrac = (val && cov != null) ? (cov / val) : null; return { sensor: sensorUsed, images: sizeUsed, totalCount: tot, validCount: val, meanNdvi: mean, coverFrac: coverFrac }; } try { console.log(`Region: center [80.0, 37.5], radius 30 km; scale ${scale} m`); const m1 = await getWindowMetrics(win1); if (m1.empty) { console.log(m1.msg); console.log('C1'); return; } if (m1.noValid) { console.log(m1.msg); console.log('C2'); return; } const m2 = await getWindowMetrics(win2); if (m2.empty) { console.log(m2.msg); console.log('C1'); return; } if (m2.noValid) { console.log(m2.msg); console.log('C2'); return; } // Validate values const invalid = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || Number.isNaN(v)); if (invalid(m1.coverFrac) || invalid(m2.coverFrac) || invalid(m1.meanNdvi) || invalid(m2.meanNdvi)) { console.log('Calculation produced null/NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (m1.coverFrac < 0 || m1.coverFrac > 1 || m2.coverFrac < 0 || m2.coverFrac > 1) { console.log('Cover fraction out of [0,1].'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Print concise evidence const vf1 = (m1.validCount / m1.totalCount) * 100.0; const vf2 = (m2.validCount / m2.totalCount) * 100.0; console.log(`${win1.label}: Sensor=${m1.sensor}, Images=${m1.images}`); console.log(`${win1.label}: Valid px ${m1.validCount}/${m1.totalCount} (${vf1.toFixed(1)}%), Mean NDVI=${(+m1.meanNdvi).toFixed(3)}, Cover>0.2=${m1.coverFrac.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`${win2.label}: Sensor=${m2.sensor}, Images=${m2.images}`); console.log(`${win2.label}: Valid px ${m2.validCount}/${m2.totalCount} (${vf2.toFixed(1)}%), Mean NDVI=${(+m2.meanNdvi).toFixed(3)}, Cover>0.2=${m2.coverFrac.toFixed(3)}`); const diff = m2.coverFrac - m1.coverFrac; console.log(`Cover change (Apr - Feb): ${diff.toFixed(3)}`); // Final Answer if (diff > 0.005) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
